name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on its flagship Diablillos high-sulphidation silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 outlining a 9,000 t/d operation with an after-tax NPV of $3 billion, has received full environmental approvals from both Salta and Catamarca provinces, and has RIGI approval under Argentina's large investment incentive regime. The company is at the construction-ready developer stage with a final investment decision targeted for Q2 2027 and first production expected before 2030.
